content.text: Many in the creative arts industry are deeply concerned about the impact of AI.
AI companies steal artists' work to build their products, then flood the market with knock-offs, meaning less money goes to human musicians.
The swift emergence of AI models has led to confrontations between the government and music legends like Sir Elton John regarding matters of copyright exemption.
Ashly Burch: 'And that, to me, as a person that loves games and loves art, is the big risk of AI, that we're going to lose out on really interesting, evocative performances.'
According to Ms. Dooner, the significant potential and rapid advancements of AI are already affecting creative sectors, including hers.
